**Repair only.** Four files, all in the Port District, all found by a fresh character on the
first visit and each played to passing before this was cut. Nothing new outside the district.

## The wrong bottle

Fernand handed you a plain potion and Juan's rescue -- which checks for Fernand's own draught by
name since 0.8.1 -- said a potion might have saved him. 0.8.1 had repointed the wrong hand-out:
the Mute Sailor's reward, not Fernand's. Fernand gives the draught now; the Mute Sailor's reward
is what it always was. The bottle is called *Fernand's Draught*.

## Juan is not a corpse

He spawned through the game's dead-body script, so the body-draining spirit skills could take
him from across the dock -- and the quest hung. He now spawns as a dying man, the way the game
poses Brother Montgomerie: nothing a corpse skill can target. Save him and he thanks you before
he moves; leave him and he tells you at twenty seconds that he is fading, and dies at
forty-five. Either way the quest closes.

## The brothers

The game wrote the reunion and never played it: Juan runs to Fernand -- *"Mi hermano! You saved
me!"* -- and Fernand answers *"Claro que si! You don't think I would let those devil fish kill
my little brother, eh?"* Then, new, Fernand chides him for fishing off the north island alone,
and sends him to the ship to lie down before he bleeds on his boots.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over 0.9.1 as normal. **Needs a character
who has not yet entered the Port District**; the bottle's name and Fernand's dialogue work on
any save.
